title: Guest Mode Production Run
h1: Shop Pay guest mode, new buyer, treatment variant
subtitle: Frames from the Playwright trace of Bashir's spec, run from Erin's machine against the production store on 2026-09-29. Each frame is an unedited screencast still.

moments.name: checkout-landing
moments.title: Checkout opens
moments.body: Cart permalink on shoppaye2etesting.myshopify.com, one Shirt at $90. The store is password-protected and the spec unlocks it first.

moments.name: shop-pay-clicked
moments.title: Shop Pay button clicked
moments.body: The express-checkout Shop Pay button opens the Accounts sign-in iframe titled "Shop Pay Quick Checkout".

moments.name: email-step
moments.title: Sign-in step loading
moments.body: The iframe renders inside the merchant checkout. Skeleton state while the login state machine initializes.

moments.name: email-continue
moments.title: Email submitted
moments.body: Benchmark alias {email}, then "Continue with shop". This is the moment the treatment decision is made.

moments.name: pay-checkout-landed
moments.title: Guest mode: straight into Pay checkout
moments.body: No phone entry, no SMS code. The Pay checkout shows the buyer email in the header with empty shipping and phone fields. This is the new behaviour under treatment.

moments.name: form-filled
moments.title: Address, phone and card filled
moments.body: Default US address, a 438555 benchmark phone, and a test card. Card and address are vaulted only at Pay now.

moments.name: order-confirmed
moments.title: Order confirmed
moments.body: Thank-you page, confirmation {order}, paid with the test card. The spec asserts "Order was completed with Shop Pay".

proves: The override header is honored from Erin's machine: treatment took effect on the first try, so Verdict trusted the request.
Under treatment a brand-new email lands in Pay checkout with no phone entry and no SMS code (frame at 9.0 s).
Address, card, Pay now and order confirmation all work end to end for the guest session.
The loop runs unattended in about 20 seconds, so more scenarios are cheap.
caveats: Only the happy path. Bug-hunt cases 5 and 19 and the ten proposed edge cases are not yet scripted.
The store is Bashir's E2E store, not one of the four bug-hunt stores.
Benchmark identities get a fixed email code and simulated SMS, so real OTP delivery is out of scope.
One run, one browser. No concurrency or second-device behaviour exercised.
